verdict.rationale: Whether source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Sprinto as a hosted proprietary compliance SaaS. The only GitHub item is a separate agent-skills repo (compliance-skills) with no stated license, not the product's own source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
